texts.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} made tea for {A_nameDef} in a small iron pot, slowly, and would not let {A_objective} drink until it had been looked at properly.
Among the Eastborn, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, a guest bows once at the gate and once at the table, and the second bow is the one that counts.
"How old are you?" {A_nameDef} asked. {X_nameDef} said, politely, that the Eastborn stop counting after the second hundred.
[night] Under the lanterns, {X_nameDef} recited a poem for {A_nameDef} about a single maple leaf, and then spent much longer explaining it.
[colony:Open] {X_nameDef} said the colony's open council would be thought very strange at the emperor's court, and rather admirable.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} came out once the sun was down and sat with {A_nameDef} just past the reach of the lamps, where {X_pronoun} said the night was kindest.
{A_nameDef} dimmed the lamp by the door without being asked. {X_nameDef} noticed, folded {X_possessive} soft wings with a shiver of thanks, and stayed to talk.
The Motz find their way by the smell of rain and the hum of the ground, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and laughed at the idea of needing a lantern.
In the coalition, {X_nameDef} explained, the councilors vote by humming, and the louder side wins. {A_nameDef} said the colony's council could use that.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} tried to sell {A_nameDef} a skull "from a very important orc". {A_nameDef} talked {X_objective} down to a handshake, and both of them seemed pleased.
In the Pact, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, a deal is sealed by spitting, and the farther the spit, the better the deal. {A_nameDef} declined to find out.
"What does the Pact actually want?" {A_nameDef} asked. {X_nameDef} thought about it for a long time. More, mostly, {X_pronoun} said, and fewer humans telling them no.
{X_nameDef} looked at the colony's walls, nodded slowly, and told {A_nameDef} that the Pact respects a place that has bothered to build them.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked {A_nameDef} which caste {A_pronoun} belonged to, and was puzzled for the rest of the afternoon by the answer.
Among the Vathun, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, a noble's horns are polished by a servant, a servant's by nobody, and a lord's by a poet.
{A_nameDef} explained the council to {X_nameDef}: everyone speaks, and the votes are counted. {X_nameDef} asked who counts them, and whether they are of good family.
[colony:Open] {X_nameDef} said the colony would be thought shockingly loose in the forest courts, then admitted, lowering {X_possessive} voice, that {X_pronoun} rather liked it.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} rode out under a vow, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, for a shrine at the end of a long road, and the road has taken six years so far.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how to keep mail from rusting: a barrel, a few shovels of sand, and rolling it for longer than anyone wants to.

[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.france] {X_nameDef} sang {A_nameDef} a song from the south of {X_possessive} kingdom, all about a lady in a tower, and then admitted {X_pronoun} had never met a lady in a tower.
[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.hre] {X_nameDef} tried to explain to {A_nameDef} how the Empire chooses its emperor. It involved seven electors, two arguments and a sigh.

[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.poland] In {X_nameDef}'s country the horsemen ride to war with wings on their backs, and {X_nameDef} swore to {A_nameDef} that the feathers really do make a sound when they charge.
[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.iberia] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about a city where three faiths share one market, and argue about everything except the price of oranges.

[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.russia] Some winters at home are so long, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, that a whole town spends them in one great hall, and by the thaw has heard every story in it twice.
[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.byzantium] {X_nameDef} described the great city to {A_nameDef}: its walls, its domes, its chariot races and its tax collectors, in that order.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} watched {A_nameDef} with the colony's animals for a while, then showed {A_objective} how the steppe folk calm a frightened beast: a low song, and never a hurried hand.
A rider of the khaganate takes five horses on a long ride, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and changes mounts without touching the ground. {A_nameDef} has been eyeing the colony's animals since.
{X_nameDef} shared a skin of fermented mare's milk with {A_nameDef}, who said it was the strangest thing {A_pronoun} had ever drunk, and asked for another.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} drew the stars for {A_nameDef} on a flat stone and showed {A_objective} how to tell the hour of the night by them.
{X_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} a way of doing sums with nine signs and a nought that made the colony's tally of the stores twice as quick.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} talked medicine late into the evening: humors, herbs, and the one book {X_nameDef} had carried halfway across the world.
[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.turks] At home, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, there is a great library where anyone who can find a quiet corner may copy any book they like.
